description:
Goal
Make the compiler2 artifact ladder a consumer of the settled TransportPlan, not a second transport calculator. Artifact may freeze closed bodies, selected call edges, effect summaries, extern marshal facts, stable inventory ids, and backend/native packaging. It must not derive shapes, lanes, callable boundaries, resume payload layouts, return ABI, or codegen representations from RuntimeDemand, TrashRuntimeValueLayout, local types, or lowered-body walks.

Signal
A worked source example proves the seam end to end before code is ripped out: producer return and delivered resume read the same ShapeId; function-entry lanes and continuation/block seams read CodegenSeamFact rows; a direct callable carried through return/resume reads CallableId target/capture facts; an escaped callable entry reads BoundaryId publication facts; ignored local use may drop lanes later but cannot change the received transport shape. rg must show artifact/materialization no longer imports or constructs TrashRuntimeValueLayout, TrashRuntimeInputLayout, TrashRuntimeParamLayout, TrashRuntimeLane, TrashReturnAbi, LocalCallableId, derive_runtime_transports, trash_runtime_value_layout_from_demand, trash_runtime_input_layout_from_demand, or trash_boundary_return_abi outside historical docs.

Strategy
Use the Output Contract Loop. First pin artifact-facing tests against TransportPlan facts and the artifact handoff shape. Then change the artifact data model so MaterializedProgram and higher rungs carry plan revision plus stable transport references/fact rows, not recursive layout trees. In the same seam commits, delete the corresponding old calculator code. No bridge is allowed: never derive TransportPlan from Trash*, never derive Trash* from TransportPlan, and never keep both authorities for a seam as a committed adapter.

Seam boundary
Input to artifact is SemanticClosed(root) plus TransportPlan(root). MaterializeRoot may wait for both facts, and may read only those settled facts plus world stores that merely intern or format already-settled ids. Transport remains the owner of TransportPosition -> ShapeId, ShapeId structure, LaneId facts, CallableId facts, BoundaryId contracts, and CodegenSeamFact rows. Artifact owns closed program packaging and stable downstream inventory over those facts.

Removal target
Delete artifact's shadow transport solver: LocalCallableProducer, LocalCallableId, LocalCallableRecord, CallableWitnessState, ExecutableCallableWitnesses, WitnessMemo, ExecutableCallableFacts, IncomingLocalCall, CallableWitnessPlan, CallableWitnessResolver, ValueWitnessFact, SettledCallableWitnesses, derive_runtime_transports, deliver_callsites/resume_delivery_demand as transport authority, trash_runtime_input_layout_from_demand, trash_runtime_value_layout_from_demand, trash_local_callable_layout, witness slots/memo joins, build_executable_abi_plan's layout-derived param reprs, derive_callable_entries' type-derived boundary selection, and trash_boundary_return_abi.

Downstream contract
This epic gates fz-hwn.19.3-.19.5. When it closes, artifact rungs expose enough TransportPlan-backed facts for backend/native/codegen tickets to stop walking old layout mirrors. If a downstream consumer still needs a Trash* shape, that need is either removed in this epic because artifact is the authority leak, or explicitly left to the downstream ticket with a named fact it must consume.

Checks
Run the targeted artifact/transport contract tests for each child ticket, then cargo check --all-targets. Before closing the epic, run cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings if the known workspace state allows it; otherwise record the exact pre-existing blocker. rg checks must prove the old artifact authority is absent from live artifact/materialization code.
title: Transport/artifact seam: make artifact consume TransportPlan and stop calculating movement
